R markdown version of `original/06d_dtw_warpdown.R`. It starts from the objects 06a saved (`data/output/dtw_cache/06a.RData`).

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here()) # run from the project root, like the .R scripts
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6, dpi = 120,
                      message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r load}
source('helpers/microHelp.R')
source('helpers/functions/fxn_mavs.R')
source('helpers/functions/fxn_dtw.R')
source('helpers/functions/fxn_stack.R')
load('data/output/dtw_cache/06a.RData') # objects from 06a
```

Instead of building up sections, trialing cutting down the tooth

- and seeing which elements are aligned in a section
- and importantly, whether cutting it makes the tooth end to an earlier part of the vert

5 gives a general idea - quick
10 fits the end much better

## SMA001 (water)

```{r sma001w, fig.height = 8}
s <- stack_alignments(SMA001T_filt, SMA001V_filt, # 1
                      elements = mavs2, # or mavs1 for just the main 4
                      spanT = 0.02, spanV = 0.04, # adjust res again, path ~ same
                      n = 1000, n_steps = c(16, 8), # how high res the map is
                      tol_um = 600, ref_step = 1000, # how (detailed) the table prints
                      plot = "heat", # for continuous scale
                      bands = c(710, # a visual of how path relates to banding
                                1715, 2900, 5900, 
                                8500, 9175, 9600))
```

```{r sma001w-indi, fig.height = 8}
s$heat(by_element = TRUE)
```

```{r sma001w-cuts, fig.height = 14}
s$plot(by_element = TRUE)
```

a couple options here looks like:
- seeing overlap between Mg, Sr, and to lesser extent Mn and Zn from 14k - 50k 
- and Li, Ba at the earlier part (4k - 35k). VERY promising

## SMA001 (bleach)

```{r sma001b, fig.height = 8}
t <- stack_alignments(SMA001TB_filt, SMA001VB_filt, # removing end due to inc holes
                      elements = mavs2, # or mavs1 for just the main 4
                      spanT = 0.02, spanV = 0.04, # adjust res again, path ~ same
                      n = 1000, n_steps = c(16, 8), # how high res the map is
                      tol_um = 600, ref_step = 1000, # how (detailed) the table prints
                      plot = "heat", # for continuous scale
                      bands = c(630, # birth
                                1210, 2400, 5600, 
                                8000, 8800, 9300))
```

```{r sma001b-indi, fig.height = 8}
t$heat(by_element = TRUE)
```

```{r sma001b-cuts, fig.height = 14}
t$plot(by_element = TRUE)
```

Ooh and all of them 22k - 50k?

## SMA002

```{r sma002, fig.height = 8}
u <- stack_alignments(SMA002T_filt, SMA002V_filt, # sawfish 1 - bleach
                      elements = mavs2, # or mavs1 for just the main 4
                      spanT = 0.02, spanV = 0.04, # adjust res again, path ~ same
                      n = 1000, n_steps = c(16, 8), # how high res the map is
                      tol_um = 600, ref_step = 1000, # how (detailed) the table prints
                      plot = "heat", # for continuous scale
                      bands = c(770, 1025, # birth and/or 1yr

```

```{r sma002-indi, fig.height = 8}

```
Ba/Mg 10k-30k
or Sr/Zn 19k-28k

```{r sma002-cuts, fig.height = 14}
u$plot(by_element = TRUE)
```

## Where two elements agree: the anchor

The anchor is the longest stretch where the alignments are within `tol_um` of each other, 
The pair is chosen per set (`anchor_pairs`, from the heat maps above). Its vertebra range is used as the anchor in 06d.

```{r agree}
anchor_pairs <- list(SMA001W1 = c("Mg_Ca_mav", "Sr_Ca_mav"),
                     SMA001B1 = c("Mg_Ca_mav", "Sr_Ca_mav"), SMA001B2 = c("Mg_Ca_mav", "Ba_Ca_mav"),
                     SMA002W1 = c("Mg_Ca_mav", "Ba_Ca_mav"), SMA002W2 = c("Zn_Ca_mav", "Sr_Ca_mav"))   
agree_settings <- list(tol_um = 500, bin_um = 500, min_bins = 3)
runs_by_set <- list(SMA001W1 = s, SMA001B1 = t, SMA001B2 = t, SMA002W1 = u, SMA002W2 = u)
agree <- lapply(setNames(names(runs_by_set), names(runs_by_set)), function(n)
  do.call(pair_agreement, c(list(runs_by_set[[n]], anchor_pairs[[n]][1], anchor_pairs[[n]][2]), agree_settings)))
anchors <- lapply(agree, function(a) if(is.null(a$stretch)) NULL else c(a$stretch$vert_from, a$stretch$vert_to))
knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(names(agree), function(n)
  cbind(set = n, pair = paste(sub("_Ca.*$", "", anchor_pairs[[n]]), collapse = " + "),
        if(is.null(agree[[n]]$stretch)) data.frame(tooth_from = NA, tooth_to = NA, vert_from = NA, vert_to = NA, median_diff_um = NA)
        else agree[[n]]$stretch))), row.names = FALSE)
```

- **pair**: the two elements compared.
- **tooth_from, tooth_to**: the stretch of tooth where the two agree (µm).
- **vert_from, vert_to**: where that stretch sits on the vertebra (mean of the two elements); the anchor for 06d.
- **median_diff_um**: how far apart the two put the tooth over the stretch (median, µm). NA = they never agree over 3 bins in a row.

```{r agree-sma001w}
agree$SMA001W1$plot
```

```{r agree-sma001b}
agree$SMA001B1$plot
agree$SMA001B2$plot
```

```{r agree-sma002w}
agree$SMA002W1$plot
agree$SMA002W2$plot
```

```{r save}
gap_um <- 350   # tooth holes wider than this (um), as in 06a's add_mavs()
sets <- list(
  SMA001W1 = list(tooth = SMA001T_filt,  vert = SMA001V_filt,  bands = c(710, 1715, 2900, 5900, 8500, 9175, 9600)),
  SMA001B1 = list(tooth = SMA001TB_filt, vert = SMA001VB_filt, bands = c(630, 1210, 2400, 5600, 8000, 8800, 9300)),
  SMA001B2 = list(tooth = SMA001TB_filt, vert = SMA001VB_filt, bands = c(630, 1210, 2400, 5600, 8000, 8800, 9300)),
  SMA002W1 = list(tooth = SMA002T_filt,  vert = SMA002V_filt,  bands = c(770, 1025, 1650, 2700, 3700, 4550, 7550)),
  SMA002W2 = list(tooth = SMA002T_filt,  vert = SMA002V_filt,  bands = c(770, 1025, 1650, 2700, 3700, 4550, 7550)))

# each version's stack_alignments() run: its runs and spans
down <- lapply(runs_by_set, function(x) list(runs = x$runs, spanT = x$spanT, spanV = x$spanV))

save(sets, gap_um, down, anchor_pairs, agree_settings, anchors,
     file = 'data/output/dtw_cache/06c.RData')
```
